facts.text: W Koh Samui is the first W in Thailand.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to the first W in Thailand.

facts.text: Every villa has its own private pool.
facts.excerpt: Every villa at W Koh Samui features its own private pool

facts.text: The resort's beach faces Maenam sunsets on one side and Bo Phut sunrises on the other.
facts.excerpt: Look left for fiery Maenam sunsets or turn your gaze towards Bo Phut to catch magical island sunrises.

facts.text: The beach is swimmable at high or low tide.
facts.excerpt: You don’t have to worry about biding the tide on our beach—high or low, it’s always in style to swim

facts.text: The resort was designed by MAPS Design Studio, with interiors by P49 Deesign.
facts.excerpt: this visionary resort is the revelation of world-renowned MAPS Design Studio, with interiors created by the award-winning firm P49 Deesign.

facts.text: From the hilltop lobby, the sea appears to merge with the infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: the most eye-catching element is simply the view from the hilltop lobby, where the sea appears to merge seamlessly with the infinity pool.

facts.text: Villa bathrooms have couple's soaking tubs and double sinks.
facts.excerpt: The luxury bathrooms in our pool villas in Koh Samui feature couple's soaking tubs and double sinks

facts.text: The Grand Residence Pool Villa is a two-story, four-bedroom villa with a beach-view balcony that has an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: a two-story, four-bedroom luxury pool villa in Koh Samui. Behold stunning beach views from an expansive balcony comprising an infinity pool

facts.text: Guests can have a floating breakfast served in their private pool.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to a leisurely floating breakfast served directly in your private pool

facts.text: AWAY Spa offers a Thaimazcal herbal sauna experience, described as Asia's first.
facts.excerpt: Try Asia’s first Thaimazcal® herbal sauna experience to cleanse and purify the body and soul.

facts.text: WOOBAR has a nightly fire show and tracks from the W Music Curator.
facts.excerpt: Chilling amid our W Music Curator's tracks, innovative lighting, nightly fire show and nibbles.

facts.text: Namu serves contemporary Japanese cuisine with Asian flavors.
facts.excerpt: Celebrate Japanese cuisine with a mix of Asian flavors at our Japanese restaurant in Koh Samui.

facts.text: SWING, a sunset tennis court, is available exclusively to guests.
facts.excerpt: SWING, our sunset tennis court, is exclusively available to guests

facts.text: Wellness sessions include Muay Thai, fitness, yoga and Pilates.
facts.excerpt: Start your morning with a Muay Thai session, fitness, yoga class, or Pilates.

facts.text: Island-hopping trips go to Ang Thong National Marine Park.
facts.excerpt: Embark on an island-hopping adventure to the spectacular Ang Thong National Marine Park.

facts.text: Guests can visit Buddhist landmarks such as the 36-foot-tall Big Buddha statue.
facts.excerpt: visit extraordinary Buddhist landmarks, like the 36-foot-tall Big Buddha statue
